title: Rahu Lands
dek: The Rahu lands marked in southwestern Prima, with Rahuvia as their capital.
body:
The Prima map marks the Rahu lands in the southwest of the island. Rahuvia is the Rahu capital; the regional map marker does not establish its precise position within those lands.

The capital and its connections

Rahuvia’s public history follows its sacred precincts, political life, and the negotiations of June 2025. The agreement names Eovar Harbor as the intermediary for later Pristinian-facing business.

The capital is a more specific location than the regional label. Read Rahuvia’s entry for its recorded history.

October · a request from the Dasa

The appeal of Kimi and Kuri distinguishes the Dasa’s interests from those of Rahu authorities. Their reported mountain route toward Vey and Vaa is approximate and unvisited by the witnesses, so it adds no exact atlas coordinates. Liberation remains a requested undertaking.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3.
sources: Quest-RP continuation — supplied 11 Oct 2026; 2,369 messages, main quest-rp and Pristinia Library; posting dates, not in-world dates
